_comment: The dashboard settings the server sends (GET /api/ui-defaults), with an operator's copy in app-config/user-configurable/ on top. Each value must fall in its range in setting-bounds.json, or for a timer setting meet the timer rule (src/lib/timer-bounds.js); one that does not stops startup, naming it. The server reads the file once, so an edit takes effect after a restart and a page reload. The dashboard asks for these after its blockchain and before it polls. The help's figures come from the same values (src/lib/resolved-settings.js). Read by src/lib/ui-defaults.js. The dashboard's other settings: ui-defaults_layout.json, built into its CSS, and ui-defaults_non-layout_for-server-down-scenario.json, built into the page for while the server is unreachable.
_reloadMaxWaitMs_comment: How long, in milliseconds, Reload Current Position waits for its scan before reloading the page anyway (14400000 = four hours). Its dialogs quote this as the longest a reload may take. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-reload-flow.js.
_pollSkipLogEvery_comment: A poll is skipped while the previous GET /api/status still awaits its answer. The browser console logs the first skip in a run, then one in every this many, so a slow server does not flood it. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-data-poll.js.
_lastCheckJustNowSec_comment: Mission Control's last-check tag reads "just now" for this many seconds after the bot's last look at the pool, then counts seconds. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-data-status.js.
_autoCompoundSyncHoldMs_comment: How long, in milliseconds, after a Stop Managing click the dashboard stops syncing the Auto-Compound toggle from status polls, so a poll answered before the server took in the stop cannot switch it back on. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-data-status.js.
_slippageConfirm_comment: Saving a per-token slippage above slippageConfirmAbovePct asks for a click on Confirm; at slippageTypedConfirmFromPct or more, for Confirm to be typed. Neither is a limit: such a value is accepted, merely costly, and the accepted range is in setting-bounds.json. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-per-token-slippage.js, which also fills both into its dialogs.
_throttleNearLimitPct_comment: The throttle badge reads NEAR LIMIT once a pool has used this percentage of its Max Rebalances / Day, while nothing blocks a rebalance yet. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-throttle.js.
_activityLogMaxEntries_comment: How many entries the Activity Log keeps, dropping the oldest. Entries logged before the settings arrive stay until the next entry. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-helpers.js.
_copyFeedbackMs_comment: How long, in milliseconds, a copy icon or button shows that it copied. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-helpers.js and src/client/web/dashboard-wallet.js.
_heapLogIntervalMs_comment: How often, in milliseconds, the dashboard logs its JavaScript heap size to the browser console (600000 = ten minutes). It is meant to stay open for days, so a figure rising for hours points at a leak. Chrome only. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-init.js.
_dashboardPollIntervalMs_comment: How often, in milliseconds, the dashboard asks GET /api/status for fresh figures; Reload Current Position checks on its scan at the same pace. The server judges from it when the dashboard has had time to poll (src/lib/config.js), so the two agree. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-data-poll.js and src/client/web/dashboard-reload-flow.js.
_staleDataCheckIntervalMs_comment: How often, in milliseconds, the dashboard checks whether the figures it shows are still another position's: from a switch to another position until the server answers about it, every figure shows a plain dash and every button is disabled, except in the disclaimer and the wallet unlock. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-stale-data.js.
_firstVisitDefaults_comment: soundsEnabled, privacyModeEnabled, privacyBlurWalletAddresses, privacyBlurUsdAmounts and privacyUsdAmountThreshold are first-visit defaults, used only while the browser has no saved choice: on a first visit, or after Settings → Clear Local Storage & Cookies. A choice made in the Settings popover is saved in the browser and wins. Read by src/client/web/dashboard-sounds.js, src/client/web/dashboard-events-manage.js and src/client/web/dashboard-privacy-subform.js.
